sources.excerpt: Current official four-tab menu was inspected completely: Starters, Entrees, Grill/Seafood/Curries, and Noodles/Rice/Sides. It exposes 99 consolidated food products and direct ingredient descriptions but no allergen matrix or cross-contact statement.

The official Carryout link resolves to the exact-address Courtside Thai Cuisine Clover storefront. Its 115 customer-facing labels were inspected and consolidated across protein and lunch/dinner variants; it adds six current ordering products beyond the official web menu.
Official Courtside Thai Cuisine site lists 3981 Chain Bridge Road, Fairfax, VA 22030, phone (703) 223-5400, and current hours: Tuesday-Saturday 11 a.m.-9 p.m., Sunday noon-9 p.m., Monday closed.
